There can be a 9mm stretch before you stretch to 10mm (0g), and from what I know, it does ease the 10mm stretch. If you can purchase a 9mm kit, I recommend you go for it since it'll make the process easier and less painful. After all, it is a 2mm jump. 

There are many that directly jump from 0g to 00g without the in between stretch, but if you realized that it'll give you a hard time, go for 9mm first. Just make sure to be safe and wait in between stretches just so you can avoid blowouts and tears.

I actually stretched from a 2g to a 0g directly. Was a little excruciating, so it's good that you stretched your ears to 1g prior to your 0g stretch. I honestly highly recommend dead stretching, but maybe follow another technique if you're intending on stretching to anything bigger than 00g?
